Bug_Title: EC: Call to equals() comparing different types (EC_UNRELATED_TYPES)
Bug_Details:
This method calls equals(Object) on two references of different
class types and analysis suggests they will be to objects of different classes
at runtime. Further, examination of the equals methods that would be invoked suggest that either
this call will always return false, or else the equals method is not symmetric (which is
a property required by the contract
for equals in class Object).
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates a bug where the equals method of an Animal object is called with a Plant object as an argument. This results in a comparison between unrelated types, which either always returns false or breaks the symmetric property of the equals method.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with an Animal and a Plant object. The equals method of Animal is not designed to handle comparison with a Plant object, leading to a failed assertion when the method returns false.
